title: Monomorphisms of etale sheaves are detected on a covering family of geometric stalks
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $(\bar s_i:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega_i\to S)_{i\in I}$ be a family of geometric points of $S$ [def-weil-geometric-point] whose images cover $S$ (every point of $S$ is the image of the point of some $\operatorname{Spec}\Omega_i$), and let $\varphi:F\to G$ be a morphism in the category $\Ab(S_{\Et})$ of abelian sheaves on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. Then $\varphi$ is a monomorphism if and only if for every $i\in I$ the induced map of stalks [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks] $\varphi_{\bar s_i}:F_{\bar s_i}\to G_{\bar s_i}$ is injective.

source.place: Etale Cohomology, Theorem 03PU (label theorem-exactness-stalks): a map of sheaves on $S_{\acute etale}$ is injective iff it is injective on the stalks at all geometric points; its proof (the surjectivity case written out, the injectivity case 'omitted') only uses, for every $u\in U$, some geometric point lying over $u$, so a family of geometric points covering $S$ suffices
